title: Learning When to Continue and When to Stop: Termination-Aware OPSD
abstract: arXiv:2611.19925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves language model reasoning by distilling from a frozen teacher initialized identically to the student and conditioned on privileged information. However, we identify an underexplored termination mismatch in OPSD: the student fails to reliably learn when to continue and when to stop. This mismatch manifests in two opposing failure modes-premature termination, where reasoning stops before sufficient progress is made, and repetition-driven over-generation, where the model continues generating after reasoning has stalled. Our analysis shows that the teacher-student discrepancy on EOS grows during OPSD training, while length-capped trajectories are frequently dominated by unproductive repetition. To address this issue, we propose TA-OPSD (Termination-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation), which augments the original OPSD objective with two targeted objectives. translated_title: 学习何时继续与何时停止：终止感知的OPSD
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过与初始化完全相同且以特权信息为条件的冻结教师模型进行蒸馏，从而提升语言模型的推理能力。然而，我们发现OPSD中存在一个此前未被充分研究的终止失配问题：学生模型无法可靠地学会何时继续推理、何时停止。这种失配表现为两种截然相反的失败模式——过早终止，即在取得足够进展之前推理就停止了；以及重复驱动的过度生成，即模型在推理停滞之后仍继续生成。我们的分析表明，在OPSD训练过程中，教师与学生模型在EOS（序列结束符）上的差异会不断增大，而受长度限制的轨迹往往被无效的重复所主导。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TA-OPSD（终止感知的在线策略自蒸馏），它在原始OPSD目标的基础上增加了两个针对性目标。其中，停止/继续蒸馏用于解决过早终止问题（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出TA-OPSD（终止感知的在线策略自蒸馏），通过引入针对终止行为的辅助目标，解决OPSD训练中学生模型无法学会何时继续推理、何时停止的问题，从而缓解过早终止与重复驱动的过度生成两类失败模式。
en_tdlr: TA-OPSD (Termination-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation) augments OPSD with targeted termination-related objectives—such as Stop/Continue Distillation—to teach the student model when to continue and when to stop, mitigating premature termination and repetition-driven over-generation.
